#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib
import itertools
import sys

TARGET = bytes.fromhex("7d39307ae824e70052c0aa16816a9b16")

COMMON = """
password password1 password12 password123 password1234 password12345 passw0rd p@ssw0rd p@ssword
admin admin1 admin12 admin123 admin1234 administrator root root123 toor letmein welcome welcome1
welcome123 qwerty qwerty123 qwertyuiop abc123 abc12345 123456 1234567 12345678 123456789 1234567890
111111 000000 654321 666666 696969 121212 112233 123123 123321 1q2w3e4r 1qaz2wsx qazwsx zaq12wsx
secret secret123 supersecret supersecret123 master master123 access login test test123 changeme
iloveyou dragon monkey football baseball sunshine princess shadow michael jennifer charlie donald
freedom whatever trustno1 killer soccer hockey ranger george computer michelle jessica pepper
paybuddies pay-buddies pay_buddies pay buddies payroll payroll1 payroll123 payroll2024 hr hr123
humanresources human-resources human_resources employee employees salary salaries finance accounting
company corporate office manager management payrolladmin payroll-admin hradmin hr-admin payadmin
payrollmanager payroll-manager hrmanager hr-manager paymaster pay-day paycheck paycheque money
P@ssw0rd P@ssw0rd123 P@ssword123 Admin@123 Admin123 Password123 Password@123 Welcome123 Welcome@123
Payroll123 Payroll@123 Paybuddies123 Paybuddies@123 PayBuddies123 PayBuddies@123 Hr@123 HR@123
""".split()


def variations(word):
    values = {word, word.lower(), word.upper(), word.capitalize()}
    for value in list(values):
        values.add(value.replace("a", "@").replace("o", "0").replace("e", "3").replace("i", "1").replace("s", "5"))
        values.add(value.replace("a", "4").replace("e", "3").replace("i", "1").replace("o", "0").replace("s", "$"))
    return values


def test(candidate):
    if hashlib.md5(candidate.encode()).digest() == TARGET:
        print(candidate, flush=True)
        sys.exit(0)


for candidate in COMMON:
    test(candidate)

words = set(COMMON)
for word in list(words):
    words.update(variations(word))

suffixes = ["", "!", "@", "#", "$", "@123", "!123", "!@#", "!!"]
suffixes += [str(number) for number in range(10000)]
for word in words:
    for suffix in suffixes:
        test(word + suffix)

for number in range(100000000):
    test(str(number))

print("NO_MATCH")
